deployments_detail.use: "Aladdin Copilot" generative AI across Aladdin investment platform; plus Asimov (equity analysis) & Thematic Robot

Aladdin Copilot: generative-AI assistant embedded across the Aladdin investment-management platform, giving users natural-language answers, report generation, research summaries and proactive alerts. Uses a plugin registry with ~50-60 engineering teams contributing tools, guardrails (input moderation, PII/toxicity filtering, hallucination detection), and GPT-4 function calling for orchestration. Now available to Aladdin clients. [Microsoft / Azure OpenAI (GPT-4)]
deployments_detail.value: Aladdin serves platform tied to ~$11T+ AUM; ~4,000 engineers / ~100 front-end apps in the Aladdin org

deployments_detail.use: Aladdin Copilot agentic architecture details: production LLMOps deployment using GPT-4 function calling for orchestration, plugin registry for federated development across ~50-60 teams, access filtering to 20-30 relevant tools, and output validation with hallucination detection. [OpenAI GPT-4 (via Azure)]
deployments_detail.value: ~11 trillion AUM served; ~100 front-end apps, ~4,000 engineers

deployments_detail.use: eFront Copilot: generative-AI chat assistant integrated into the eFront Insight private-markets platform, allowing users to analyze private-markets investments and surface insights on demand. First rolled out as a private preview to select eFront clients, then made broadly available within eFront Insight. [Microsoft / Azure OpenAI]
deployments_detail.value: Private preview launched to ~10 eFront clients

deployments_detail.use: BlackRock Systematic uses machine learning, neural-network portfolio construction, and large language models / generative AI in production to read filings, financial texts and social media for sentiment, and to process alternative data (e.g. ~30M US job postings) to generate investment signals and alpha. [none disclosed (in-house ML/LLM + alternative data)]
deployments_detail.value: ~$336B AUM; grown from 3 signals (1985) to 1,000+ today; ~90% of funds beat peer median over 5 years

deployments_detail.use: eFront Insight end-to-end private-markets workflow launch featuring automated visual analytics and AI-enhanced tools for LP manager due diligence (evaluating strategy, track record and operations), integrating Preqin pre-investment data with eFront post-investment workflows. [BlackRock Aladdin / eFront / Preqin]
